description:
The module doc of the DVB-T2 LDPC table module spans several sections and cites the standard by prose title. It is reduced to the workspace comment contract so the source-comment sweep holds for every file under `crates/`.

## Background

`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/dvb_t2_matrices.rs` opens with a `//!` block of sections "Table Format", "Structure", "Code Rates" and "References" that restates constants and names ETSI EN 302 755 by title and version. The root `AGENTS.md` limits a module-level doc to one short orientation paragraph plus the contract statements its public API needs, and `external-claims-cited` requires a registry key for an external work. The generated-data exception of the sweep preserves provenance headers of the tables, which stay unchanged.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The module doc is one short orientation paragraph plus the contract statements no single item of the module owns, and each statement is true of the code.
- [hard] REQ-02: The standard is cited through its registry key, and no prose title or version of it remains in the module doc.
- [hard] REQ-03: The remaining comments of the file meet the same comment rule; provenance headers of the generated tables keep their bytes.
- [hard] REQ-04: The diff contains only comment, Rustdoc and whitespace edits and deletes more lines than it adds; Rustdoc builds without new warnings and the Rust CI gate passes.
title: Reduce the DVB-T2 LDPC table module doc to the comment contract
